title: Questions

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Um, excuse me. You're the owner of this stand, correct?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Um, excuse me. You're the owner of this stand, correct?

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Ah, that's great, thank you. I am a professor over at Central Canyon. Professor Kasey Remo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, that's great, thank you. I am a professor over at Central Canyon. Professor Kasey Remo.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I'm wondering if you might recognize this person? Her name is Zee Burke. Does she look familiar at all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm wondering if you might recognize this person? Her name is Zee Burke. Does she look familiar at all?

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Of course, of course. But, see, the thing is though, the last time she came to my lecture, she had one of your take away containers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course, of course. But, see, the thing is though, the last time she came to my lecture, she had one of your take away containers.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Same reason you or anyone else would ask a question, to learn information. My name is Kasey Remo. I'm a professor at Central Canyon University and I'm hoping you could assist me with something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Same reason you or anyone else would ask a question, to learn information. My name is Kasey Remo. I'm a professor at Central Canyon University and I'm hoping you could assist me with something.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Unfortunately. Given the circumstances, it isn't really that nice of an occasion I'm afraid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfortunately. Given the circumstances, it isn't really that nice of an occasion I'm afraid.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I'm afraid I don't know. She seems to have... disappeared.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm afraid I don't know. She seems to have... disappeared.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Ah, now see, that makes sense. Her first paper was about the Docks. It was elegant. Well beyond her years. It's what first caused me to take notice of her work. There was something there. A gift to academia.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, now see, that makes sense. Her first paper was about the Docks. It was elegant. Well beyond her years. It's what first caused me to take notice of her work. There was something there. A gift to academia.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: She was. And I hope she will be again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She was. And I hope she will be again.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: If you're actually insinuating that I had an inappropriate relationship with one of my students, you can choke on the very food you cook.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're actually insinuating that I had an inappropriate relationship with one of my students, you can choke on the very food you cook.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I'm afraid she hasn't been to a lecture for some time. In fact, no one's seen her here for over a week. With the news of this serial killer, I'm more than a little concerned.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm afraid she hasn't been to a lecture for some time. In fact, no one's seen her here for over a week. With the news of this serial killer, I'm more than a little concerned.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Possible, but not probable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Possible, but not probable.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I teach in the history department of the Central Canyon Technical Institute. Ethical hacking and Grid Pathways through the ages.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I teach in the history department of the Central Canyon Technical Institute. Ethical hacking and Grid Pathways through the ages.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I would love nothing more than to go into the fascinating world of ethical hacking, however I'm afraid I'm on a mission. Help me find Zee and I'll teach you things that history forgot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would love nothing more than to go into the fascinating world of ethical hacking, however I'm afraid I'm on a mission. Help me find Zee and I'll teach you things that history forgot.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Though she spent her time at the docks, Zee lived in Eastern Residential. She had a friend there, a photographer named Sanya Predex. Maybe you could speak with her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Though she spent her time at the docks, Zee lived in Eastern Residential. She had a friend there, a photographer named Sanya Predex. Maybe you could speak with her?

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I have to attend a conference on the implications of fully augmenting the human brain, I'm supposed to be the keynote speaker but I don't know if I have it in me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have to attend a conference on the implications of fully augmenting the human brain, I'm supposed to be the keynote speaker but I don't know if I have it in me.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Well, that is most unfortunate, but I suppose it's understandable. Missing people are nothing new. If you happen to see her in your travels, please let me know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, that is most unfortunate, but I suppose it's understandable. Missing people are nothing new. If you happen to see her in your travels, please let me know.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Your generosity with your time is beyond appreciated.
